title: Reimagining AI: Exploring Speculative Design Workshops for Supporting BIPOC Youth Critical AI Literacies
reasoning: The paper describes speculative design workshops aimed at fostering critical AI literacy and exploring social and ethical perceptions of AI among BIPOC youth. While AI ethics is a central theme of the workshop curriculum, the research focuses on human-computer interaction and educational design rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks, morals, or religious beliefs within an AI model or system.
